name: codecooksage-ai
description: AI-powered code reviews inside VS Code. Instant, expert-level feedback on bugs, security, performance and code quality from any OpenAI-compatible provider, with automatic model rotation so a rate limit never ends your session.

enumDescriptions: OpenRouter — hosted gateway across many providers
OmniRoute — self-hosted gateway; set baseUrl to your instance
Custom — any other OpenAI-compatible endpoint; set baseUrl
codesage-ai.provider.description: Provider preset. Every option must expose an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint.

codesage-ai.baseUrl.description: API base URL, for example http://localhost:8080/v1. Leave empty to use the provider preset's default. Required for the omniroute and custom presets.

codesage-ai.model.description: Model identifier to request. Run "CodeSage: Select Model" to pick from what your provider actually serves. Used as the single route when "codesage-ai.routes" is empty.

codesage-ai.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens in the AI response. The ceiling is the largest any current model accepts; your provider rejects anything the chosen model cannot deliver.

codesage-ai.temperature.description: Controls response creativity. Lower = more focused, higher = more creative.

enumDescriptions: General -- Balanced review covering bugs, security, performance, and readability
Security -- Focused security audit: vulnerabilities, OWASP, secrets, injection
Performance -- Performance analysis: complexity, bottlenecks, memory, I/O
Clean Code -- Readability, SOLID, naming, refactoring
codesage-ai.reviewProfile.description: Review profile that tailors the AI's review focus.

codesage-ai.enableCodeLens.description: Show 'Review' buttons above functions, methods, and classes.

codesage-ai.enableStreaming.description: Stream review results in real-time as the AI generates them.

codesage-ai.routes.markdownDescription:
Ranked pool of models to rotate through. Leave empty to use the single `#codesage-ai.model#` setting.

When this list is non-empty it **replaces** the single model: reviews try tier 1 routes first and fall back to higher tiers only when every better route is rate limited. Capacity is routes multiplied by the number of API keys stored for each provider.

Example:

```json
[
  { "model": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4", "provider": "openrouter", "tier": 1 },
  { "model": "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1", "provider": "openrouter", "tier": 2 },
  { "model": "qwen2.5-coder:14b", "provider": "ollama", "tier": 3 }
]
```

model.description: Model identifier as the provider spells it.

baseUrl.description: Endpoint for this route. Defaults to the provider preset, or to "codesage-ai.baseUrl" when the provider matches.

tier.description: Preference rank. Tier 1 is tried first; higher tiers are fallbacks.

label.description: Name shown in notifications and the rotation pool view.

codesage-ai.requestTimeoutMs.description: Abort a request after this many milliseconds of silence. While streaming the clock restarts on every chunk, so a slow model is not cut off mid-review. Set to 0 to wait indefinitely.

codesage-ai.maxAttempts.description: How many pool slots one review may try before giving up. Each failure parks that slot for as long as the provider asked for, so later reviews skip it without paying the round trip.

codesage-ai.maxQueueWaitMs.description: When every route is throttled, wait up to this long for the first one to recover instead of failing. Longer pauses are reported rather than waited out. Set to 0 to never wait.
